exclusion_method: Blu Tack attachment excluded from the original textured mesh; 337 gray shaft-reflection faces outside the attachment interval were restored. Exact original face indices and exclusion provenance are in references/stylus-reference-mask.json.
obscured_region: Approximately Z35.74 to64mm in stylus coordinates is hidden by Blu Tack; the nominal straight cylinder reconstructs this interval.

cavity.hidden_geometry: Smooth ungrooved writing-tip master offset by 0.1001 mm, joined to cylindrical straight-withdrawal envelope. Concealed OEM internals are not recovered.
cavity.blind_tip_clearance: 0.1001 mm normal offset and axial blind allowance; independently sampled native closest-wall map, distinct from observed scan geometry.
cavity.exposed_geometry: Measured tapered side keyway, rounded start and asymmetric local mouth roll. Local inner root relief provides nominal running clearance.

previous_clean_reference.storage: Superseded filtered target retained in the local development archive; not required by this project.

head_reconstruction: Continuous solid extraction rib with measured waisted sections and rounded crown; prior cantilever gap and rectangular bridge rejected.

grooves.method: Measured revolved annular profiles and a bounded local rib patch, followed by exact half mirroring.
